fun_facts: In his junior season, Mark Fletcher Jr. set career highs with 216 carries, 1,192 rushing yards and 12 rushing touchdowns, and earned third-team All-ACC recognition.
Across four College Football Playoff games, he rushed for 507 yards and averaged 6.8 yards per carry.
He rushed for 172 yards against Texas A&M during Miami’s playoff run.
In the national championship game against Indiana, he rushed for 112 yards and scored twice.
Against Stanford, he rushed for 106 yards and a career-high three touchdowns.

basis.reasoning: The cited ESPN account states Fletcher’s junior-season career highs and All-ACC selection, along with his combined playoff rushing total and his individual performances against Texas A&M and Indiana. The Stanford recap reports his 106 rushing yards and career-high three touchdowns.

excerpts:
* * *

## 4\. [Mark Fletcher Jr.](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4870736/mark-fletcher-jr) , Miami

**2025 stats:** 1,192 rushing yards, 5.5 yards/carry, 17 receptions, 140 receiving yards, 14 TDs

Fletcher cemented himself among the sport's elite big-game performers during Miami's playoff run last season. The Fort Lauderdale, Florida, native totaled 507 rushing yards on 6.8 yards per carry across four CFP games, an overwhelming stretch that included a 172-yard effort against Texas A&M and a 112-yard, two-touchdown performance against Indiana in January's national title game.

Mark Fletcher Jr.'s spectacular performances in the CFP showed he can deliver on the biggest stage.
A third-team All-ACC selection, Fletcher set career highs in carries (216), rushing yards (1,192) and rushing touchdowns (12) in his junior season.
